notes.title: Wicked Cabins – A Cozy Diorama Builder with a Horror Twist!
notes.content: [p][/p][p]Hi everyone! 👋[/p][p] [/p][p]I’m Dariusz Pietrala and I’ve been doing games solo and with teams for a couple of years now. This game is a cool idea I had a few months ago. Hopefully it’s gonna be chillingly relaxing.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="tqKZH-PvVj0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Wicked Cabins[/b] is a diorama builder where you create cozy hideaways in the eeriest of places. There are no monsters to fight or puzzles to solve. It’s just a calm, creative space where you can take your time and turn darkness into something warm and inviting. No rush, no pressure, just you and your imagination.[/p][p][/p][p]I’m excited to share the vibe and invite you into the spooky yet comforting world of [b]Wicked Cabins[/b]. I’ll be posting updates here, sharing new features and sneak peeks as development moves forward. Right now, I’m experimenting with ways to make your cabins feel even more alive. Think of strange creatures that loom over your cabin, lush vegetation, and environments that will bring your cabin to life.[/p][p][/p][p]I’d love it if you followed along and joined the conversation here. Your thoughts and ideas are crucial because this is the first cozy game for me. And I can’t wait to build this spooky world with you.[/p][p] [/p][p]You can wishlist [b]Wicked Cabins[/b] right now![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3824610/Wicked_Cabins/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If you want to help with Wicked Cabins apply here: [url="https://forms.gle/odq1jhJjH1BafBhr6"]https://forms.gle/odq1jhJjH1BafBhr6[/url] and I'll reach out to you as soon as the game is available for content creators.[/p][p][/p][p]Warm (and eerie) wishes,[/p][p]Dariusz[/p]
